<MethodEndpoint
  method={"post"}
  path={"/openapi/reward/applyCoupon"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Validates and applies a single coupon code entered by the customer, returning the
resulting discount breakdown. Unlike `validateReward` which evaluates all eligible
rewards automatically, this endpoint targets only the coupon code supplied in
`couponCode`. Use this for explicit coupon entry flows — for example, when a customer
types or scans a coupon code at the POS. Like `validateReward`, this endpoint is
non-committing — call `rewardRedeemed` after a successful payment to finalise.
